title: Niladri Kumaar Shows, Tickets and More. Follow Now!
description:
Niladri Kumaar, one of India’s most celebrated contemporary classical artists. A sitar virtuoso and visionary composer, he is the creator of the Zitar, a groundbreaking fusion of sitar and guitar that has reimagined the possibilities of Indian classical music.

Trained in the rich legacy of Hindustani classical tradition, his artistry bridges heritage and innovation with effortless finesse. His work transcends genres, weaving together classical depth, global influences, and a distinctly modern sensibility, establishing him as a pioneering force shaping the future of Indian sound.

title: Kanha Kamboj Shows, Tickets and More. Follow Now!
description: Kanha Kamboj is a poet–musician whose work blends shayari and singing into intimate, emotionally driven performances. Known for his soft delivery and sufi-tinged sound, his words move gently between spoken poetry and melody, creating experiences that feel personal and reflective. His live sets are shaped like modern mehfils — minimal, honest, and rooted in feeling rather than spectacle.

title: Rakesh Chaurasia Shows, Tickets and More. Follow Now!
description: Rakesh Chaurasia (b. 1971, Allahabad) is a Grammy-winning Indian flautist of the bansuri and nephew of maestro Hariprasad Chaurasia. A prodigy groomed in the Kirana tradition, he blends classical purity with global fusions—jugalbandis, jazz, flamenco. He’s toured worldwide, earned multiple prestigious awards, and secured two Grammys in 2024.

title: Mukul Sharma Shows, Tickets and More. Follow Now!
description: Mukul Sharma isn’t just a singer—he’s a storyteller. With every lyric and every note, he weaves emotions into melodies that resonate far beyond the stage. Recently, he celebrated performing to a sold-out audience of 1,000 people, calling it “not just a show, but love, poetry, and us.

title: Purbayan Chatterjee Shows, Tickets and More. Follow Now!
description:
Purbayan Chatterjee is one of the most revered sitar maestros of the world, and belongs to the Senia Maihar Gharana founded by Baba Alauddin Khan. His gurus are his father Pt. Parthapratim Chatterjee, Ustad Ali Akbar Khan, and he’s undergone vocal training from Pt. Ajay Chakraborty and training in tabla from Pt. Arindo Chatterjee. 

Among the list of awards that he has received there is the Indian president awards, Aditya Vikram Birla award, Rotary international award, in addition to many other prestigious awards. 

Purbayan's music is inspired by the sound of Pt. Nikhil Banerjee. His music combines the tone and richness of the Nikhil Banerjee style and a contemporary touch of his own urbane sensitivity. He has conceptualised the ground-breaking project Shastriya Syndicate - the first Indian Classical Band - with a contemporary touch, which has
performed all over the world. Their album ‘Lehar’ released by Times Music in 2008
remained the best-seller for a year and a half.

Purbayan regularly collaborates with the likes of Shankar Mahadevan, Ustad Zakir
Hussain and the jazz legend Pat Metheny. He also has several international albums to his credit, apart from many classical albums on top record labels of the world. His albums ‘Leher’ and ‘Stringstruck’ have received several awards and have been celebrated worldwide. 

Today he is one of the most sought-after musicians in the country and a global
ambassador for Indian classical music.

title: Abijit Ganguly Shows, Tickets and More. Follow Now!
description: A Bengali living in Delhi, Abijit Ganguly's humor tackles the most mundane Indian problems like parents, pressure of getting married and buying condoms in the most unapologetic way. The bi-lingual comedian performs in both Hindi and English, is over 2000 shows old and NDTV has repeatedly named him as one of the Rising Stars of Comedy in India. When he is not packing venues on comedy nights or doing corporate shows, the Delhi School of Economics graduate poses as a brand consultant to major multi-corporations like Woo, Sprite, Culture Machine and OYO Rooms, and also as a freelance writer. The comedian has appeared on various TedX Talks, dishing gyan about being on stage, following dreams, and earning your bread in the process.

title: Atul Khatri Shows, Tickets and More. Follow Now!
description: Can businessmen be funny? Yes. Meet Atul Khatri, a middle-aged businessman-turned-comedian who now makes a living making people laugh harder than they ever have. A former member of one of the country's leading comedy collectives, East India Comedy, Atul has often been spotted on their YouTube series like EIC Outrage, and specials such as EIC vs Bollywood. Bringing his 40+-year-old perspective with every show, he performs regularly at comedy clubs and does private shows in India and abroad. The comedian has showcased his skills at the prestigious Utrecht International Comedy Festival in the Netherlands and Belgium, and at the 8th Annual Hong Kong International Comedy Festival in 2014. CNN-IBN recently rated him as one of the Top 20 Comedians in India to Watch Out For, post winning the competition CEOs Got Talent.
